articles.title: Leeds defeat Chelsea 4-1 at Stamford Bridge
articles.summary: Noah Okafor scored twice to secure Leeds United a 4-1 victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge, marking their first win at the venue in 27 years and lifting them to sixth place in the Premier League table.

articles.title: Arsenal draw with Newcastle to extend lead
articles.summary: Noni Madueke scored a crucial second-half goal to earn Arsenal a 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park. The result moves the reigning champions six points clear at the summit of the Premier League table.

articles.title: Teenager Williams-Barnett inspires Spurs win
articles.summary: Tottenham Hotspur teenager Luca Williams-Barnett starred in Roberto de Zerbi's side, delivering a standout performance as they secured a comfortable victory against Ipswich Town in the Premier League.

articles.title: Coventry beat Palace in Frank's first game
articles.summary: An 85th-minute own goal by Dwight McNeil handed Coventry City a 3-2 win over Crystal Palace. The result moves Coventry three points clear of the relegation zone while ruining Thomas Frank's first match in charge of Palace.

articles.title: Fulham hold Manchester City to a draw
articles.summary: Manchester City ended their losing streak as Elliot Anderson scored a fantastic volley to help them come from behind and secure a draw against Fulham, earning City their first Premier League point in over a month.

articles.title: Evanilson scores again as Bournemouth win
articles.summary: Evanilson scored in his sixth consecutive Premier League match to help Bournemouth defeat Nottingham Forest 2-0 at the Vitality Stadium, continuing their impressive run under their new manager.

articles.title: Aston Villa held to draw by Sunderland
articles.summary: Aston Villa's ongoing struggles at home continued as they were held to a goalless draw by a dogged Sunderland side in the Premier League, failing to break down the visitors' resolute defense.

articles.title: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya faces injury scan
articles.summary: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to undergo a scan on his shoulder injury after being forced off during the latter stages of Saturday's 2-2 Premier League draw away against Newcastle United.

articles.title: Chelsea held by Liverpool as London City win
articles.summary: Khiara Keating produced a resilient goalkeeping performance to deny Women's Super League leaders Chelsea in a 0-0 draw against Liverpool. Meanwhile, London City Lionesses closed the gap at the top by beating Crystal Palace 6-2.

articles.title: Hearts demolish Dundee 8-0 in Scottish Premiership
articles.summary: Hearts secured a remarkable 8-0 victory over 10-man Dundee in the Scottish Premiership, with Wouter Vrancken praising it as his team's best performance since he took charge at Tynecastle, ending a three-match losing streak.

articles.title: PSG's Doue carried off with serious knee injury
articles.summary: Desire Doue was carried off in tears after suffering a nasty right knee injury while playing for Paris Saint-Germain in their 3-2 victory against Nice in Ligue 1, following an awkward twist while trying to control the ball.

articles.title: Elon Musk's lawyer joins Chelsea stake buyers
articles.summary: Alex Spiro, a lawyer representing Elon Musk and Joshua Kushner, is seeking to buy a minority stake in Chelsea by investing in majority owners Clearlake Capital, joining former NFL player Tom Brady in discussions.

articles.title: France reach Nations Championship final
articles.summary: France secured their place in the Nations Championship final after producing a dominant display to defeat Argentina 45-17, scoring seven tries in the process during Saturday's international rugby match.

articles.title: Australia edge past Wales in close match
articles.summary: Wales failed to build on their previous victory against New Zealand as Australia narrowly edged their tightly contested Nations Championship encounter 29-26 in Cardiff, leaving the Welsh side falling just short at the end.
